demonstration_passes.note: Live testnet transactions of the two demonstration passes, read from the chain, each between two named demonstration VASPs. This is data, not a reproducibility claim; it is replayed by scripts/demo/corridor-fx-e2e.mjs, which reads each receipt on the public RPC and renders its state. Both arrival transactions carry EVM status success: the refusal is semantic (the composer rolls the swap back and keeps the value in transit), not a reverted transaction. Party names (BANK FR, BANK SG1, BANK SG2) are demonstration labels for identified financial institutions, not central bank entities.
